# Untransformed vs Log Transformed Gaussian Response (Posterior Predictive Check)

*Goal: Compare untransformed vs log transformed responses for gaussian response
mixed models*

Let $y_i^{\text{obs}}$ be the $i$th observed response, and let 
$M(\mathbf{y}^{(\theta)})$ be the vector of predicted responses.

We use the expected absolute loss function to compare the log and non-log
transformed models:

$\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^{N}|y_i - M(\mathbf{y}^{\theta})|$




```{r}

## Simulate data
set.seed(123)
n = 400

# Assign normal distribution outcomes

x <- runif(n = n , min = 0, max = 1)
y <- rnorm(n = n, mean = 5* x, sd = 3) + 10

ndat <- data.frame(x, y)

# Fit model
fit <- bayesics::np_glm_b(formula = y ~ x, family = "gaussian", seed = 123, data = ndat)


# Model components:
# (Cant seem to get posterior y_i draws)

fit$fitted |> # Posterior Means
  head()

bayesics::get_posterior_draws(fit) |> # Posterior beta draws (no sigmas)
  head()

predict(fit) # Posterior means and CI's

 



```

## Simulate data

```{r}

set.seed(123)
n = 400

# Set data
x <- runif(n = n , min = 0, max = 1)


# Assign normal distribution outcomes
y <- 5 * rnorm(n = n, mean = x, sd = 3) + 10
ndat <- data.frame(x, y)

# Assign log normal distribution outcomes
y <- exp(rnorm(n = n, mean = x, sd = 1))  # Exponentiated response!
ldat <- data.frame(x, y)


# Compare plots
ggplot(ndat) + geom_histogram(mapping = aes(x = y)) + labs(title = "Normal Outcome")

ggplot(ldat) + geom_histogram(mapping = aes(x = y), bins = 40) + labs(title = "Lognormal Outcome (Nontransformed)")
ggplot(ldat) + geom_histogram(mapping = aes(x = log(y)), bins = 40) + labs(title = "Lognormal Outcome (Transformed)")


```

Untransformed lognormal data looks amenable to log transformation.


# Expected Absolute Loss

Calculates expected absolute loss statistic between observed values
and median posterior. This is done for both a log-transformed and untransformed
response.

```{r}


fit1 <- bayesics::np_glm_b(formula = y ~ x, family = "gaussian", seed = 123, data = ndat)

# Get posterior draws of parameters
post_draws <- bayesics::get_posterior_draws(fit1)
post_draws |>
  head()

# Form design matrix from the data
design_mat <- t(model.matrix(fit1))

# Matrix multiply to get posterior means
post_means <- post_draws %*% design_mat

# Collect means over all posterior draws
colMeans(post_means)


# ! This does not match with the posterior mean from predict()
predict(fit1, seed = 123) |>
  head()

predict(fit1, seed = 456) |>
  head()


ael_stat <- function(n_formula, l_formula, data){
  
  n_fit <- rstanarm::stan_glmer(formula = n_formula, data = data) # Modelling untransformed response
  l_fit <- rstanarm::stan_glmer(formula = l_formula, data = data) # Modelling transformed response
  
  # Get posterior predictions
  n_predictions <- rstanarm::posterior_predict(n_fit)
  l_predictions <- rstanarm::posterior_predict(l_fit)
   
   ndraws <- nrow(n_predictions) # These will be the same for both model types
   nobs <- ncol(n_predictions)
  
   # Get observed quantities
   observations <- matrix(rep(n_fit$y, times = ndraws), nrow = ndraws, ncol = nobs, byrow = TRUE) # Again, same for both types

   # Get posterior medians
   n_medians <- matrix(rep(apply(n_predictions, MARGIN = 1, FUN = median), each = nobs), 
                       nrow = ndraws, 
                       ncol = nobs, 
                       byrow = TRUE)
   l_medians <- matrix(rep(apply(exp(l_predictions), MARGIN = 1, FUN = median), each = nobs), 
                       nrow = ndraws, 
                       ncol = nobs, 
                       byrow = TRUE) # Transformed onto non-log scale
   
   # Calculate average distance between observations and posterior median
   n_diffs <- abs(observations - n_medians)
   l_diffs <- abs(observations - l_medians)
   
   # Calculate the average of these differences
   n_ael <- mean(abs(n_diffs))
   l_ael <- mean(abs(l_diffs)) 
   
   
  rslt <- list(n_predictions = n_predictions,
               l_predictions = l_predictions,
               observations = observations,
               n_medians = n_medians,
               l_medians = l_medians,
               n_diffs = n_diffs,
               l_diffs = l_diffs,
               n_ael = n_ael,
               l_ael = l_ael,
               n_fit = n_fit,
               l_fit = l_fit)

  return(rslt)
  
  
}


# Results from normal distributed response
comp <- ael_stat(n_formula = y ~ x | group,
                 l_formula = log(y) ~ x |group,
                 data = ndat)

comp$n_ael
comp$l_ael



# Results from lognormal response
comp2 <- ael_stat(n_formula = y ~ x | group,
                 l_formula = log(y) ~ x |group,
                 data = ldat)


comp2$n_ael
comp2$l_ael



```
